purpose: Verify Faculty, Dept_Admin, and HOD are permitted to create department announcements.
preconditions: Faculty, Dept_Admin, or HOD user authenticated.
action_or_input: Actor submits announcement creation request.
expected_result: Announcement created and published successfully.

purpose: Verify other roles (e.g. Student) are prohibited from creating announcements.
preconditions: Student user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit announcement creation request.
expected_result: Request is refused with 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify announcement is visible when viewer matches role, program, and academic year targeting.
preconditions: Announcement targeting role=STUDENT, program=BTech, academic_year=3 exists.
action_or_input: BTech 3rd year student retrieves announcement list.
expected_result: Targeted announcement is included in results.

purpose: Verify announcement is filtered out when viewer does not match targeting criteria.
preconditions: Announcement targeting role=FACULTY, program=ALL, academic_year=0 exists.
action_or_input: Student retrieves announcement list.
expected_result: Announcement is excluded from results.

purpose: Verify publication succeeds when required content and target-scope are provided.
preconditions: Actor is authorized.
action_or_input: Submits announcement with complete title, content, target_role, target_program, target_year.
expected_result: Announcement published successfully.

purpose: Verify publication is blocked when required content is missing.
preconditions: Actor is authorized.
action_or_input: Submits announcement with blank title or content.
expected_result: Publication blocked with 400 Bad Request.

purpose: Verify only HOD may edit, hide, or delete active department announcements.
preconditions: Active announcement exists. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD performs edit, hide, or delete operation.
expected_result: Operation succeeds and announcement status/content updates.

purpose: Verify non-HOD actors are denied from editing, hiding, or deleting active announcements.
preconditions: Active announcement exists. Dept_Admin or Faculty authenticated.
action_or_input: Non-HOD actor attempts to edit, hide, or delete announcement.
expected_result: Request is refused with 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify Faculty is permitted to submit stock requests for department inventory.
preconditions: Faculty user authenticated; inventory item exists.
action_or_input: Faculty submits stock request.
expected_result: Stock request created in Pending HOD Approval state.

purpose: Verify non-Faculty actors (e.g. Student) are denied from submitting stock requests.
preconditions: Student user authenticated; inventory item exists.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit stock request.
expected_result: Request is refused with 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify only HOD may approve or reject pending stock requests.
preconditions: Pending stock request exists. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD approves or rejects the request.
expected_result: Request transitions to Approved for Issuance or Rejected.

purpose: Verify non-HOD actors are denied from deciding on stock requests.
preconditions: Pending stock request exists. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to approve or reject the request.
expected_result: Request is refused with 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin may issue stock for HOD-approved stock request.
preconditions: Stock request has HOD approval (status=APPROVED_FOR_ISSUANCE). Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks request as issued.
expected_result: Request status becomes ISSUED, quantity decremented, movement logged.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin cannot issue stock for request lacking HOD approval.
preconditions: Stock request is in PENDING_HOD or REJECTED status. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to mark request as issued.
expected_result: Request refused (400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict) and remains unissued.

purpose: Verify non-Dept_Admin actor cannot issue stock.
preconditions: Stock request is approved for issuance. Faculty authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty attempts to mark request as issued.
expected_result: Request refused with 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify authenticated Students and Faculty may submit feedback.
preconditions: Student or Faculty authenticated.
action_or_input: Actor submits feedback.
expected_result: Feedback accepted in New state.

purpose: Verify unauthenticated or unauthorized actor cannot submit feedback.
preconditions: Unauthenticated client.
action_or_input: Attempts feedback submission.
expected_result: Request refused with 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin may close simple feedback issue during initial review.
preconditions: Feedback in initial review. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks feedback as Closed.
expected_result: Feedback transitions to CLOSED.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin or HOD may mark feedback as Resolved or Closed.
preconditions: Feedback is Under Review. HOD or Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Actor marks feedback as Resolved.
expected_result: Feedback transitions to RESOLVED.

purpose: Verify submitter or unauthorized actor cannot mark feedback Resolved or Closed.
preconditions: Feedback is Under Review. Student authenticated.
action_or_input: Student attempts to mark feedback as Resolved.
expected_result: Request refused with 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify conflict-free timetable changes are permitted to save.
preconditions: Slot has no time/room conflicts.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits timetable entry.
expected_result: Timetable entry saved successfully.

purpose: Verify overlapping timetable slot is blocked and not saved.
preconditions: Slot in Room 101 on Mon 09:00-10:00 already exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits overlapping slot in Room 101 on Mon 09:30-10:30.
expected_result: Save is blocked (400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict) and no overlapping entry persisted.

purpose: Verify proposed official department detail remains pending and does not become effective until HOD approval.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated. Current department name is 'Old Dept'.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin proposes official change to 'New Dept'.
expected_result: Proposal is in Pending HOD Approval state; current department name remains 'Old Dept'.

purpose: Verify Headship identity is excluded from official detail proposal path.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to change department head identity via official detail proposal.
expected_result: Request is rejected as unsupported/immutable in this path.

purpose: Verify Faculty resource views are limited to explicitly permitted department resource information.
preconditions: Faculty authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty views lab resource profiles and own issued stock history.
expected_result: Permitted lab profiles and own stock history returned.

purpose: Verify Faculty cannot view department resource information outside Faculty scope.
preconditions: Faculty authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty attempts to query administrative or other faculty stock requests.
expected_result: Out-of-scope data is not disclosed (403 Forbidden or filtered out).

purpose: Verify only HOD may approve or reject pending official department-detail change.
preconditions: Official change proposal in Pending HOD Approval. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD approves or rejects the proposal.
expected_result: Decision recorded; if approved, detail becomes effective; if rejected, detail retained.

purpose: Verify non-HOD actor cannot decide on pending official department-detail change.
preconditions: Official change proposal exists. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to approve or reject the official change proposal.
expected_result: Request refused with 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify stock request enters pending approval when requested quantity is available in current inventory.
preconditions: Current inventory quantity is 10.
action_or_input: Faculty submits request for quantity 10.
expected_result: Validation passes; request enters Pending HOD Approval.

purpose: Verify stock request is blocked when requested quantity exceeds current inventory.
preconditions: Current inventory quantity is 10.
action_or_input: Faculty submits request for quantity 11.
expected_result: Request blocked at submission (400 Bad Request) and does not enter HOD approval.

purpose: Verify stock insertion and issuance create immutable movement log entries.
preconditions: Dept_Admin inserts stock item and later issues approved request.
action_or_input: Inspect movement log records.
expected_result: Immutable movement logs exist for both INSERT and ISSUE operations.

purpose: Verify stock movement log cannot be altered or deleted through normal module operations.
preconditions: Movement log record exists.
action_or_input: Attempt PATCH, PUT, or DELETE on movement log record.
expected_result: Operation refused (405 Method Not Allowed or 403 Forbidden).

purpose: Verify feedback is visible only to submitter, Dept_Admin, and HOD.
preconditions: Student A submits feedback. Dept_Admin and HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: Student A, Dept_Admin, and HOD request the feedback item.
expected_result: Feedback content is accessible to all three authorized actors.

purpose: Verify feedback content is not exposed to other department users/peers.
preconditions: Student A submits feedback.
action_or_input: Student B attempts to retrieve Student A's feedback item.
expected_result: Access refused (403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found); confidential feedback withheld.

purpose: Verify newly submitted feedback must undergo initial review by Dept_Admin.
preconditions: Feedback in 'New' state. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin performs initial review and assigns category.
expected_result: Status becomes 'Under Review / Categorized' and feedback is now accessible for HOD oversight.

purpose: Verify HOD acts on feedback after Dept_Admin initial review.
preconditions: Feedback in 'Under Review'. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD performs oversight resolution.
expected_result: Feedback is resolved or closed.

purpose: Verify Students receive basic permitted peer/Faculty profile information.
preconditions: Student queries peer or faculty profile.
action_or_input: Student requests profile details.
expected_result: Basic permitted fields returned; phone and sensitive contacts excluded.

purpose: Verify Faculty receives detailed profile information for students in their courses.
preconditions: Student enrolled in Faculty course.
action_or_input: Faculty queries student profile.
expected_result: Detailed academic student profile returned.

purpose: Verify HOD and Dept_Admin receive full profiles excluding privacy-protected sensitive data.
preconditions: Dept_Admin or HOD queries user profile.
action_or_input: Retrieve profile details.
expected_result: Full administrative profile returned; privacy-protected sensitive fields masked.

purpose: Verify central Institute Admin is authorized to assign HOD and Dept_Admin roles.
preconditions: Institute Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Institute Admin creates role assignment for department.
expected_result: Role assignment is recorded; displayed Headship synchronizes with active HOD.

purpose: Verify local department actors are denied from assigning HOD and Dept_Admin roles.
preconditions: HOD or Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Attempts role assignment creation.
expected_result: Request refused with 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify department maintains exactly one active HOD and one active Dept_Admin assignment.
preconditions: Department has one active HOD and one active Dept_Admin.
action_or_input: Query active role assignments for department.
expected_result: Exactly one active record returned for each role.

purpose: Verify creating concurrent active assignment without transition is blocked.
preconditions: Active HOD assignment exists.
action_or_input: Attempt to create second active HOD assignment overlapping same validity interval without transition.
expected_result: Creation blocked (400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict) preserving cardinality.

purpose: Verify role assignment tenure validity interval is recorded and enforced.
preconditions: Role assignment created with start_date and end_date.
action_or_input: Check tenure validity interval and expiration status.
expected_result: Interval is enforced; role is active only within defined date window.

purpose: Verify outgoing role access is revoked and incoming access is granted immediately upon effective transition.
preconditions: Reassignment effective date is reached.
action_or_input: Execute effective role transition.
expected_result: Outgoing user role access revoked; incoming user role access granted; no overlap.
